verdict.rationale: Motion has built-in event-driven behaviors: projects advance when blocking tasks complete, user-set daily meeting limits are enforced automatically, forwarded emails become tasks, and an 'AI Workflow Builder' builds workflows from SOPs. General trigger→action rules, however, appear to depend on the external Zapier integration. Missing for 10: documented native user-defined rule/trigger engine, choice of trigger events and actions, details on how the AI Workflow Builder configures automations, and hands-on corroboration.
